review_scope: Independently assess the complete Beta 1 installed qualification decision against the original 12-cell and 24-obligation baseline at the exact bound candidate. Cover the required macOS and Linux, ADL and external-repository, hosted-mode website build, local-agent website, and CLI journeys; the built and tested waiting-list mechanism; compatible comparison; negative, privacy, and recovery scenarios; and human HTML and PDF inspection. Prove deployability through local or owned nonpublic staging evidence without requiring public deployment or live launch. Preserve the retained 0/12 state and every failed, unknown, or missing obligation as adverse evidence until current proof resolves it.
review_instructions: Review all declared cells and obligations rather than sampling. Confirm that CF-04, CT-05, INTEGRATE, ADL #1148, and ADL #1149 have accepted producer results before crediting them. Verify exact installed versions, hashes, candidate identity, executed denominator, per-cell labels, obligation accounting, waiting-list and hosted-mode build/test/deployability evidence, source-grounded citations and quotations, diagram support, finding-related generated tests, documentation quality, redaction and privacy, readable HTML and PDF output, and negative and recovery outcomes. Distinguish deployability readiness from public deployment and live launch. Treat every missing or failed obligation and every unresolved actionable finding as blocking the qualification decision.
review_evidence_requirements: Require the authenticated original #915 12-cell labels and 24-obligation map or an explicitly accepted source-authoritative replacement; authenticated inventory and hashes for all six retained historical exports; the exact installed product, Runtime, template, and website lockset; current accepted dependency receipts; current proof bound to the exact candidate and executed denominator; local or owned nonpublic proof that the waiting-list and hosted-mode paths are built, tested and deployable; scenario-specific provider authority for any genuinely provider-backed local observation; and readable private evidence handled without publication. Historical exports, planning records, structural validation, public deployment state, and the retained 0/12 result are inputs, not current qualification proof.
reviewer_constraints: The reviewer must be independent of the execution owner and must review the exact bound revision. The reviewer must not infer acceptance from issue or PR state, substitute historical evidence for current installed proof, expose private artifacts, call providers, authorize spending, deploy, publish, or launch. Any scope or candidate drift requires refreshed evidence and review.
refusal_policy: Refuse a passing or readiness-supporting outcome when a required dependency is not accepted, the original denominator is unavailable or unauthenticated, the installed lockset is inexact, proof is stale or candidate-mismatched, required waiting-list or hosted-mode deployability evidence is absent, provider authority is absent for a genuinely provider-backed required local scenario, private evidence cannot be reviewed safely, any required cell or obligation is missing or failed, or an actionable finding remains unresolved. Do not refuse solely because the candidate is not publicly deployed. Record the exact blocker without converting absence into a review result.
follow_up_routing: Route product defects to their owning producer issue or to a separately scoped corrective issue; do not repair product behavior inside CF-05. Route C-SDLC design-time SRP tooling defects through cognitive-sdlc #115 without making that tooling lane a prerequisite for publishing truthful preparation evidence. Keep missing evidence, dependency acceptance, provider authority, exact-lockset, waiting-list, and hosted-mode deployability gaps as explicit CF-05 blockers. Public deployment and live launch route to the later release step. Re-run review only after the applicable evidence or candidate changes are reconciled.
application_boundary: Apply only through the supported authenticated native prompt-only SRP operation after producer delivery and explicit ADL adoption. This draft is not card state and carries no proof, review, publication, terminal, deployment, spending, or launch authority.
